design_philosophy: A modern, clean, high-trust fintech-style interface. Reassuring rather than flashy. Minimalist, transparent, security-forward. Neutral backgrounds, restrained color use, bold typography for key amounts or outcomes, and subtle success/error states. Avoid casino-flashy aesthetics. Use pure structural grayscale for hierarchy and vibrant orange/gold only for key actions.

rules.headings: Use 'Outfit'. Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not use default bold everywhere; use font-medium or font-semibold selectively.
rules.body: Use 'DM Sans'. Clean, highly legible for numbers and data.
rules.numbers: Use tabular-nums for live results and balances to prevent layout shifting.
rules.labels: Uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-wider) for overlines and small labels.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto for mobile app view, max-w-7xl for admin dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing. Use p-4 or p-6 for cards. Use gap-4 for lists.
spacing_and_layout.radius: Sharp but safe edges. Use rounded-lg (8px) or rounded-xl (12px) for cards. Avoid fully pill-shaped buttons unless for small tags.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Minimalist. Use shadow-sm for default cards, shadow-md on hover. No heavy drop shadows. 1px borders preferred over shadows.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento style for dashboard stats. Strict 1-column list for markets on mobile.

Header.style: Sticky top, bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md, z-50, border-b border-slate-200. Clean display of Wallet Balance.
Header.interactions: Clicking wallet opens Add Funds drawer.

MarketCard.style: Flat design, bg-white, border border-slate-200, rounded-xl, p-4. Grid layout inside for Open/Close times and Live Result.
MarketCard.typography: Market Name in Outfit font-semibold text-lg. Live result in large, tabular-nums (e.g., text-3xl font-bold tracking-widest text-primary).
MarketCard.status: Dynamic Play Button: Primary brand color if Open. Gray/Disabled if Closed.

ScrollingNotice.style: bg-brand-gold_light text-brand-primary py-2 px-4 text-sm font-medium. Use react-fast-marquee.

BottomNav.style: Fixed bottom, bg-white border-t border-slate-200. Flex justify-between, pb-safe.
BottomNav.icons: Use Lucide React. Active state gets brand primary color, inactive is text-slate-400.

AdminStatsCard.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-6. Big numbers in Outfit font-semibold text-3xl. Subtitle in text-sm text-slate-500.

BetSlip.style: Drawer or fixed bottom sheet overlay. Clear input fields for digits, amount. High-contrast 'Place Bid' CTA.

motion.hover: Subtle transform -translate-y-0.5 and shadow-md for cards.

images.description: Gold abstract texture for premium banners or VIP sections.
Professional customer support agent for live chat/whatsapp contact section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against brand primary meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using a mobile-first approach. For the user app, simulate a mobile viewport (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto, hidden scrollbars) with a fixed bottom navigation.
For the admin panel, use a desktop-first dashboard layout with a sidebar.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. Link the fonts in index.html.
Ensure the Market List Cards clearly display Open/Close times and the Live Result in a prominent, easily readable format.
Implement Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like Drawers, Modals, Tabs, and Tables.
The styling must strictly avoid purple/teal gradients and dark casino themes. Stick to the crisp white, slate grays, and vibrant orange/gold.
